expectations.quote: Operable capacity is the sum of the operating and idle capacity
expectations.expected: 8D0 is headline petroleum refinery capacity, atmospheric crude distillation basis. Operating/idle are components; prefer operable. Calendar-day and stream-day bases stay separate. No adding downstream unit capacities to invent a refinery total.
Stream-day potential and calendar-day usual operating capacity are not interchangeable. Preserve units and January 1 reference date. Count of facilities is neither capacity nor customers.

expectations.quote: The maximum amount of product that can be produced from processing facilities.
expectations.expected: Individual petroleum product capacities remain components; hydrogen and sulfur are outside the fixed product vocabulary. Capacity is not observed production.

expectations.quote: The difference in volume between the maximum safe fill capacity and the quantity below which pump suction is ineffective (bottoms).
expectations.expected: Working storage volume is capacity, not stocks. Refinery-only population is not all-facility storage; compare broader facility populations separately from refining throughput.

expectations.quote: The design capacity of a petroleum storage tank
expectations.expected: Shell design capacity and working usable capacity remain different bases. Do not call either observed stocks or processing capacity.

expectations.quote: Beginning in 2011, the Refinery Capacity Report does not contain working and shell storage capacity data.
expectations.expected: Retain historical break; successor report is separate. Current broader report is discontinued, not evidence of current absence or zero. Do not join histories automatically.

expectations.quote: Foreign crude oil is reported as a receipt only after entry through customs.
expectations.expected: Refinery receipts describe delivery to facilities, not customs imports, production, final consumption or sales. All domestic/foreign/transport-mode receipt measures are outside fixed activity vocabulary.
Actual fresh-feed processing input is outside fixed activity vocabulary; do not map YDR to capacity merely because its short process name contains Capacity. Full table/series establish throughput.

expectations.quote: 50 States, the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico, the U.S. Virgin Islands, Guam, and other U.S. possessions
expectations.expected: Preserve source geography facets and crosswalk; report population does not imply each national series includes all territories. No guessed place codes.

expectations.quote: by type of facility, product, and Petroleum Administration for Defense District
expectations.expected: Refinery storage is one facility population of broader storage reporting. No whole economy storage-capacity claim from refinery-only records; no off-API data ingestion.
